properties.notes: Former church hall within a established residential area of Morpeth. The building has been in a state of disrepair, to the point of latterly becoming disused. No longer fit for purpose, the cost of refurbishment are prohibited, so the facility has been identified as surplus to requirements of the Church. Would be available for redevelopment following demolition, although this is likely to require provision of replacement space on a new site to enable this. Initial outline permission for 3 dwellings on clearance was approved in 2014 (14/00136/OUT). This was followed by a detailed permission for a revised scheme of 5 new-build homes (16/00145/REM). This scheme was part of a wider proposal for consolidation. Extensive and costly work would have been required to make the necessary improvements to the existing hall and new facilities have now been provided at nearby St Aidenís Church site in replacement, subject of a separate but related permission (14/00134/FUL). Development of 5 dwellings completed in 2018/19.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
